def: petty (in size or number); adverbially, a short (time)

words.word: thither is it not a little one

occurrences.text: Behold now, this city is near to flee unto, and it is a little one: Oh, let me escape thither, (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live.
words: thither is it not a little one

occurrences.text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and the Lord delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
